info.description: Colecci?n ?nica de LigaVolley. Las carpetas Admin, Scorer y Public contienen cobertura can?nica; los recorridos end-to-end encadenan contratos, y 90 contiene casos de error. No duplicar requests de cat?logo fuera de escenarios que necesitan estado previo.

item.name: 00 - Setup y diagnóstico
item.description: Seleccionar un environment de despliegue. Los IDs producidos durante una corrida se guardan como variables de colección.

exec: pm.test('Documenta las tres superficies', () => { const paths = Object.keys(pm.response.json().paths); pm.expect(paths.some(x => x.startsWith('/api/admin/'))).to.be.true; pm.expect(paths.some(x => x.startsWith('/api/scorer/'))).to.be.true; pm.expect(paths.some(x => x.startsWith('/api/public/'))).to.be.true; });

item.name: 01 - Admin
item.description: Preparación, administración y supervisión. Todos los requests usan /api/admin.

exec: pm.test('Invalid rule limits are reported without persistence', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.isValid).to.eql(false); pm.expect(r.errors.filter(x => x.code === 'invalid_match_rule_limit')).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('Format exposes match rule defaults', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.maxSubstitutionsPerSet).to.eql(6); pm.expect(r.maxTimeoutsPerSet).to.eql(2); });
pm.test('Incluye la inscripción', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.teamEntryId == pm.collectionVariables.get('entryId'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test('200 y scope de grupo', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().phaseGroupId.toString()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('phaseGroupId')); });

pm.test('200, CanComplete false y blockers', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.canComplete).to.be.false; pm.expect(body.blockers).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('200, Finished y primera ejecución', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Finished'); pm.expect(body.alreadyCompleted).to.be.false; });

pm.test('200, Finished y AlreadyCompleted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Finished'); pm.expect(body.alreadyCompleted).to.be.true; });

pm.test('200 y contadores consistentes', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.matches.total).to.eql(body.matches.pending + body.matches.inProgress + body.matches.finished + body.matches.cancelled); });

pm.test('200 y blockers', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.canComplete).to.be.false; pm.expect(body.blockers).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('Finished con movimientos históricos', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Finished'); pm.expect(body.alreadyCompleted).to.be.false; pm.expect(body.completedAt).to.not.be.null; pm.expect(body.movements).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Cierre idempotente con movimientos históricos', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Finished'); pm.expect(body.alreadyCompleted).to.be.true; pm.expect(body.movements).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('409 con blockers estructurados', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('competition_cannot_complete'); pm.expect(body.blockers).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test('200 y reemplazo atÃ³mico de fuentes', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('200 y composiciÃ³n completa', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); ['sources','remaining','promotedIn','relegatedIn','otherEligible','warnings'].forEach(key=>pm.expect(body[key]).to.be.an('array')); });

request.description: Admin read-only confirmed effective court (including underlying regular), libero history, origin and recorded decision.

item.description: Consola operacional y sincronización. Todos los requests usan /api/scorer.

item.name: MatchSheet Opening

item.description: Incluye rules.maxLiberos/liberoEnabled y candidatos habituales informativos. La declaración efectiva sólo se envóa en POST /open.

item.description: Una lista ausente, null o vacía declara cero MATCH_LIBERO. La función habitual del roster nunca completa la lista.

item.description: Debe devolver 400 match_requires_six_players cuando un lado no tiene seis convocadas.

item.name: Rechazar exceso de declaraciones de líbero
item.description: Debe devolver 400 too_many_match_liberos cuando la lista contiene más declaraciones que el máximo efectivo.

La convocatoria y los l?beros se congelan en POST /open. La funci?n habitual del roster s?lo es una sugerencia de UI; liberoCompetitionRosterPlayerIds es la declaraci?n efectiva. Ejecutar ejemplos negativos contra un Match nuevo.

item.name: Lineup HOME con plan de líbero por plaza lógica

request.description: Six regulars. Optional libero plan supplies suggestions only; no automatic entries. Positions 0..5, multiple candidates allowed.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200 && !pm.response.json().alreadyApplied) { const s=pm.response.json().state; pm.test("Start never invents a libero replacement",()=>pm.expect([...s.homeCourtState,...s.awayCourtState].some(p=>p.isLiberoReplacement)).to.eql(false)); }

item.name: Point (Runner loop)
item.description: Definir winningSide por set: HOME para sets 1,3,4 y AWAY para set 2. El Runner repite este request hasta que setStatus sea Finished.

request.description: Observed entry or direct acting-libero exchange. replacedMatchPlayerId is the effective outgoing player; preserves the underlying regular. Allowed before first point after StartSet. Confirm specific warnings; never consumes substitutions.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const s=pm.response.json().state; pm.test("At most one effective libero per team",()=>{ [s.homeCourtState,s.awayCourtState].forEach(c=>pm.expect(c.filter(p=>p.isLiberoReplacement).length).to.be.at.most(1)); }); }

request.description: Observed exit restores the current logical regular (including substitutions under coverage). No automatic exit occurs on points.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const s=pm.response.json().state; pm.test("At most one effective libero per team",()=>{ [s.homeCourtState,s.awayCourtState].forEach(c=>pm.expect(c.filter(p=>p.isLiberoReplacement).length).to.be.at.most(1)); }); }

item.name: Rules Assistant v1
item.description: Independent scenarios on a prepared IN_PROGRESS demo. Use Frozen rules first. Substitution examples require the indicated regular players on court and incoming players outside court. Timeout confirmation requires HOME at its frozen limit. Run the timeout warning, confirmation and retry in that order. Refresh rulesSequence before a new sync scenario. Each initial action creates a UUID; confirmation and retry preserve it.

item.name: 03 - Public
item.description: Consulta anónima y read-only. Todos los requests usan /api/public.

exec: pm.test('central live state and canonical public server',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const x=pm.response.json();pm.expect(x.serverTime).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(x).to.have.property('lastUpdatedAt');pm.expect(x).to.have.property('servingSide');pm.expect(x).to.have.property('servingPlayer');if(x.servingPlayer!==null){pm.expect(x.servingPlayer).to.have.all.keys('jerseyNumber','displayName');pm.expect(Number.isInteger(x.servingPlayer.jerseyNumber)).to.eql(true);pm.expect(x.servingPlayer.displayName).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(x.status).to.eql('InProgress');pm.expect(x.sets.find(s=>s.setNumber===x.currentSetNumber).status).to.eql('InProgress');pm.expect(x.servingSide).to.be.oneOf(['Home','Away']);}if(x.status!=='InProgress'||!x.sets.some(s=>s.setNumber===x.currentSetNumber&&s.status==='InProgress'))pm.expect(x.servingPlayer).to.eql(null);});
